content.doc_md:
Noneis a special constant in Python that represents the absence of a value.

Its data type isNoneType, andNoneis the only instance of aNoneTypeobject.

Variables can be assignedNoneto indicate "no value" or "not set".

Usetype()to see the type of aNonevalue.

To compare a value toNone, use the identity operatorisoris not

Noneevaluates toFalsein a boolean context.

Functions that do not explicitly return a value returnNoneby default.

### Code Snippets

```
x = None
print(x)
```
